name: LITD Les Veilleurs - Blender Modeling Execution Plans v52
purpose: Fournir un plan de construction Blender concret, ordonné et vérifiable pour chacun des douze maîtres v51.
pc_sequence: Open/create the exact source_blend path for plan 01.
Separate runtime BODY parts and create STUMP/break geometry.
Build the rig in the declared order and validate F0 deformation.
Run every F3 test, then every F4 test.
Build and inspect LOD1/LOD2 without merging damage boundaries.
Author the real P0 Actions required by v47/v48.
Export GLB and run v49/v50 Godot validation.
Only after the current master is approved, continue to the next order number.
definition_of_ready_before_pc: All twelve plans exist, match the v51 source_blend paths and anatomy contracts, and pass the static v52 audit.
definition_of_done_after_pc: All twelve real .blend assets exist with artist-authored geometry, rigs, F3/F4 variants, LODs and real P0 Actions, then pass v49/v50 and human visual review in Godot.
truth_rule: Static v52 validation proves production instructions are coherent; it does not prove that any .blend model, rig, material, LOD or animation has been artistically created.
